canonical.question: What Park Loop Road route and seasonal road closure does the National Park Service Acadia directions give?
canonical.expected_primary: The scenic 27-mile (43 km) scenic loop begins at Hulls Cove Visitor Center and offers access to Sand Beach, Thunder Hole, Otter Cliffs, Jordan Pond, and Cadillac Mountain.
canonical.expected_secondary: The Park Loop Road closes annually, from Dec 1 through April 14, with spring road opening being weather-dependent.
canonical.tampered_primary: Park Loop Road is open to motor traffic year-round without seasonal closure.
